read_scope: Complete 90-line midpoint-coordinate and 69-line original-host sample sources, their exact candidate manifest and all six listed providers.

checks: The finite exceptional set is the exact set in the same-retained classification theorem. The image of the actual sum of the two endpoint-to-midpoint absolute differences is finite and bounded; each individual endpoint difference is bounded by that sum, including an empty exceptional set.

Every nonexceptional component retains the same P.sideRadius scaling and actual two Morse gap endpoints. The real midpoint is the scaled midpoint by an explicit ring identity. The actual four-point gap ordering places both the chosen endpoint and midpoint in the closed gap used by the existing X-oscillation theorem.
The common endpoint-to-midpoint constant is max L (max B 0), chosen before the component and side. No endpoint cell or whole-component containing cell is asserted.

For the host comparison, the actual shared root is the right negative endpoint when side=false and the left negative endpoint when side=true. The original host interval remains unchanged and the closure provider supplies its index bound at that actual root.
The five one-sided comparisons are X(sample j)<=index j+B, index j<=X(root)+B, X(root)<=X(midpoint)+L, X(midpoint)<=index k+B, index k<=X(sample k)+B. Thus the exact total cost is L+4B.

The material comparison is invoked with r=sample k and s=sample j, so its second conclusion is precisely E0(sample j)^R <= K1*E0(sample k)^A for R>=0. Both sample core-memberships come from the genuine IsMaterialData/IsAccumulatingProfile providers.

K1>0 and A>=0 precede all components, sides and cell labels. No E0>=1, reverse comparison, retained-certificate extraction from arbitrary Through03, alternative sample, or final primitive bound is assumed.
All source/provider/manifest SHA256, Git blob and line-count identities were checked; both new public names have no installed declaration collision.
